name: rimLighting
description: Properties for configuring stylized additive rim lighting. Formula is: color * intensity * pow(1.0 - dot(normal, dirToCamera) + bias, power)

properties.name: enable
properties.description: Enable the rim lighting feature for this material. When disabled, the shader skips the rim lighting calculation.

properties.name: color
properties.description: Tint of the rim highlight. Color is displayed as sRGB but the values are stored as linear color.

properties.name: intensity
properties.description: Brightness multiplier for the rim highlight. A value of 0 removes the visible rim even when the feature is enabled.

properties.name: power
properties.description: Controls the width of the rim highlight. Lower values create a wider, softer rim; higher values create a tighter edge highlight.

properties.name: bias
properties.description: Offsets where the rim starts. Positive values spread the rim farther across the surface; negative values keep it closer to the edge.
